## Acknowledgement

Sequence numbers, packet headers and acks: which of your packets the other side received.

<!-- nova-work:acks:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| packet header with sequence, ack and ack bits | ✅ |
| sequence buffers, including the 16-bit wrap | ✅ |
| acks for every packet received | ✅ |
| acks under packet loss | ✅ |
| duplicate packets ignored | ✅ |
| stale packets dropped | ✅ |
| ack buffer overflow handled | ✅ |
| a packet the process callback rejects is not acked | ✅ |
| complete | 100% |

## Fragmentation

Packets larger than a fragment are split on send and reassembled on receive.

<!-- nova-work:fragments:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| send and receive packets | ✅ |
| large packets fragmented and reassembled | ✅ |
| abandoned reassemblies cleaned up | ✅ |
| unfinished reassembly has a byte budget | ❌ |
| complete | 75% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:fragments:end -->

## Robustness

Hostile wire data never throws: malformed, stale, duplicate and truncated packets are counted and dropped; no allocation at steady state.

<!-- nova-work:robustness:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| truncated headers refused and counted | ✅ |
| hostile fragments refused and counted | ✅ |
| parser fuzz and the C fuzz_target.c script harness | ✅ |
| seeded adversarial soak | ✅ |
| zero allocation at steady state | ✅ |
| invalid configuration refused at construction | ✅ |
| configuration refuses exactly what C refuses | ❌ |
| an empty received packet is counted, not thrown | ❌ |
| complete | 75% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:robustness:end -->

| STANDARD.md vendored verbatim, drift checked | ✅ |
| interop gate and spec follow the current C release | ❌ |
